options.name: credential_file
options.description: Path to the credential file associated with the service account, we assume the json file is in the same location of the playbook.

options.name: groups
options.description: A list of groups to update their signature.

options.name: groups_definition
options.description: A list of groups that exists in the domain.

options.name: signature_folder
options.description: Full path to folder where jinja2 template of signature is located. We use the option 'signature' from the properties of the user to set the filename. The template need to use '.j2' extension

options.name: used_by
options.description: User in the domain with access to use the service account.

options.name: users
options.description: A list of users to update their signature.

options.name: users_definition
options.description: A list of users that exists in the domain.
